verdict.rationale: Superhuman is documented only as a client that connects to existing Gmail and Outlook accounts. Mail history stays with those host providers. The evidence shows no import or migration tool that brings mail history or contacts from another provider or client into Superhuman. Connecting an existing Gmail or Outlook account is a host-platform arrangement, not a product-owned import capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
